subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing rhetorical devices: repetition, rhetorical questions, and parallelism
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student reads a passage aloud, noticing the rhythm created by repetition or parallel structure
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a rhetorical device to the sentence example that demonstrates it
exercise.abstract: Student identifies a rhetorical device in a given passage and explains its persuasive effect

misconception_flags: identifies the device correctly but cannot explain what effect it has on the reader

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
